cohort: 68 parturients undergoing emergency cesarean section with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia, some with and some without COVID-19 infection, from a single tertiary university hospital in Wuhan, China.
finding: Patients with COVID-19 had different ACE levels and lower blood pressure after CSEA compared to those without COVID-19, and lower ACE levels predicted lower systolic blood pressure after CSEA in COVID-19 patients, suggesting ACE may be a biomarker for anesthesia effects.
